run_mrp_processes: run one or more MRP processes with optional dependency resolution and build steps
build_mrp_process: build an MRP process using the runtime build method with cache and verbose options
down_existing_processes: stop conflicting running processes before starting new ones with force flag
get_transitive_closure: compute the transitive closure of process dependencies from a list of process names
attach_to_process: attach to a single running MRP process after it starts
